 The policy states that BMI 
should not be used exclusively to identify obesity; instead, it should be used in conjunction with other 
assessment tools. The policy acknowledges the BMI assessment is based on data from non-Hispanic White 
populations and does not consider differences in body shape and composition across different race/ethnic 
groups, sexes, or age groups (AMA, 2023).
